purpose: Test whether matching the frozen CNN pose input during additional student DAgger improves transfer beyond equal-budget simulated-noise DAgger.
status: prepared_before_new_training; waits for the entire existing frozen formal suite to complete

training.optimizer: Adam with new optimizer state, zero weight decay

development.metric: unchanged low-level full-quaternion reach <=0.16 rad before drop under released diagnostic horizon; not autonomous semantic success

admission.eligibility: CNN candidate must strictly exceed both frozen latent and extra-simulated reach counts and have no more drops than either, on the complete fresh development set. Otherwise keep the existing student. This is a development gate, not a significance claim.
admission.controller_compatibility: Existing recovery actors are checkpoint-bound. A new student requires separate control collection, fitting and agent validation before any release.
admission.future_agent_evaluation: New reserved seeds 183301/183302, forty raw trials per condition, same autonomous success and exclusions. Do not run or inspect these states during training/development.

limitations: The two on-policy training trajectories can diverge. Equal budgets do not mean identical training states.
RGB is calibrated GS object plus black hand occlusion, not full-scene or real-camera evidence.
The plan is motivated after seeing previous formal outcomes. It is a new development experiment, not a preregistered explanation of the old result.
gpu_start_condition: No compute processes, memory < 2048 MiB, utilization < 10 percent, after all 320 frozen formal slots are verified complete.
